title: LinPipe Asset
description: Fields shared by every downloadable LinPipe asset (models, libraries, ...).

timestamp.description: When this config was generated (ISO 8601 date-time).

name.description: Asset name; should match its key in the corresponding index file.

requirements.description: Names of other assets that this asset depends on.

files.description: Files that belong to the asset, usually a single archive to download and decompress.

name.description: File name, as stored locally after download and decompression (if any).

url.description: Where to download the file from.

compression.description: Compression of the file; no compression if missing.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file (before decompression), as 64 hex characters.
